column3: Hired Thief
Thief Chief
Hired Thief
Another quiet day in Imil,\nand the lighthouse is still\ndark.{end_wait}
Megan and Justin can manage\nwithout me for an hour. I\njust needed some air.{end_wait}
That's her, the one with\nblue hair and healer's\nrobes. Don't let her get to{page_break}the village.{end_wait}
Excuse me, are you lost?{end_wait}
No, we're here for you. Be\nnice about it and nobody\ngets hurt.{end_wait}
Three men with knives, on\nthe road to my village. I'm\nnot going to ask twice.{end_wait}
You're all useless. Fine,\nI'll do it myself.{end_wait}
Keep her busy, kid, and\ndon't let the healer run.{end_wait}
Your men are on the ground.\nWalk away while you still\ncan.{end_wait}
I don't walk away from paid\nwork, girl.{end_wait}
Who sent you?{end_wait}
Nobody hired us. We\nheard healers carry\nmedicine worth selling.{end_wait}
You waited on this road.\nYou knew I'd come.{end_wait}
We watched the village.\nYou take this road alone.{end_wait}
The roads are empty.\nWe thought no one would\ncome looking for you.{end_wait}
And if I had refused?{end_wait}
We'd have taken what\nwe could and left you.{end_wait}
We didn't expect you\nto fight back.{end_wait}
Then remember this:\nImil is not defenseless.{end_wait}
Get up, take your men and\ngo. If I see you near Imil\nagain, I won't stop.{end_wait}
...All right, we're going.{end_wait}
I'll warn the village.\nYou won't get another\nchance.{end_wait}
